title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to show Experience Tier (Essential or Premium) on the Companies (list page)
summary: This post explains how to add a visible Experience Tier column (Essential or Premium) to the Companies list page, since this setting is not directly displayed by default. The solution uses AL code with a page extension to retrieve and display the experience tier for each company.
key_points: Experience Tier is stored in the Experience Tier Setup table, not in the Company table or Company Information page
The Experience setting controls which features users can access (Essential vs Premium functionality)
A page extension on the Companies list uses the Experience Tier Setup table to retrieve and display the tier for each company
The code uses RecordRef and FieldRef to dynamically read experience tier values from the Experience Tier Setup record

quotes.text: Business Central is designed to help you run your business regardless of the size and complexity.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the purpose of configurable experience tiers to support businesses of different sizes

quotes.text: The Experience setting isn't directly visible in the Companies list.
